name: cliproxyapi-resumable-protocol-streams
instr:
CLIProxyAPI cannot resume interrupted streams without restarting provider execution or duplicating usage. Add opaque-cursor resumption on the same endpoint, disabled by default and bounded per service.

Expose the session and cursor before negotiated stream data. Sequential and concurrent attachments share the authenticated execution, ordered records, immutable terminal outcome, authentication accounting, and result marking. Reject malformed, unknown, expired, future, endpoint-mismatched, and discarded-state cursors atomically before replay or execution is visible. Enforce the session-count limit by evicting the least-recently-accessed detached session; attach and snapshot refresh access recency. Enforce the per-session byte limit by evicting complete records in insertion order. Only complete post-interceptor deliveries consume sequence positions. Bootstrap attempts without accepted output create no gaps or sessions; later successful retries remain resumable without another execution or accounting. Post-delivery failures terminate the session. Disconnects detach resumable consumers without cancelling bounded sessions; ordinary streams retain existing headers, framing, cancellation, errors, and termination.

Preserve native boundaries and terminal rules for OpenAI chat and legacy completions, OpenAI Responses, Claude Messages, and Gemini SSE and JSON-array output. Responses keeps typed sequence values and sanitized failures, including unchanged later values after replacement a
